messages:
maya: Quick q — for SOC2 readiness we need a product decision on telemetry sampling for security vs general metrics when a customer uses BYOK. Is our plan to keep 1:1 audit events but sample perf/trace? cc @sam @leo

sam: Short answer: yes for audit events. Proposal: 100% retention for 'audit' class (auth, keystore ops, admin actions). Sample non-audit telemetry (metrics/traces) by default at 10%. Allow per-tenant override as paid tier.

leo: Legal note: we should define 'audit' narrowly. Anything that could be evidence in discovery or SOC2 should be 1:1. Also if a customer requests multi-year retention (e.g., 7 yrs) we need export/playbook for BYOK since hosted can't decrypt customer keys on our side.

irene: Ops implications: full audit retention for hosted customers increases storage & egress costs. For Dedicated/private we can keep it internal. For hosted BYOK, propose a gated add-on (billing + ops review) that provisions encrypted archive buckets.

maya: Good points. Draft acceptance criteria to ship this feature: 1) decision doc + event taxonomy (audit vs telemetry) 2) UI/Onboard flag for 'full-audit retention' and billing notice 3) BYOK export/playbook + keystore handshake runbook 4) tests: retention e2e + export replay test 5) SOC2 control mapping doc.

sam: I can draft the decision doc. One open q: sampling granularity — per-tenant default with route-level overrides? ops prefers tenant-level to keep complexity down.

leo: Also need to update SOC2 mapping: which event IDs qualify as evidence. I'll attach a sample list in the doc.

maya: For product prioritization: propose P2 (ship in next 6-8 weeks) assuming no major infra blockers. If infra says more time, we adjust.

ops-bot: INF ticket created: INF-7365 — implement retention tiers + BYOK export workflow. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-7365 :white_check_mark:

maya: OK — sync tomorrow 09:00 PT to align scope, I'll add calendar invite and attach Sam's initial draft when ready. :calendar: 

sam: Will post draft before the sync. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
